notes: cancel_flagged (the contract section names its origin: FLAG_CANCELED on the event) is handled exactly like cancel (design section 3.3); the section does not say the app treats it differently
thresholds are design proposals (design-m02 section 3), not calibrated on a device; they change here, with a new detectorVersion
edge distances and edge_exit use the touch-surface edges in the surface-local frame (surfaceWidthPx x surfaceHeightPx), not the physical screen edges
lift_break is a server-side name for a break with a lift; it is not a wire value

conventions.cellOfPoint: floor(x / cellWidthPx), floor(y / cellHeightPx) clamped to the grid; not stated by the contract section; agrees with the cells the producer reported on its three fv71 samples (NeuralChek@f9e0571)
conventions.cellIndex: row * gridCols + col (contract section, untouchedCells / cutoutCells / notRequiredCells)
conventions.requiredCells: all cells minus cutoutCells minus notRequiredCells, as the producer declared them (frame + X, 2026-10-21); the server does not compute the pattern geometry; a path touch in a not-required cell is counted apart and not as a required touch
conventions.intervals: dtMs are whole milliseconds: at 240Hz (4.17 ms) the interval is rounded, so the derived rate is approximate
